findings.message: .blueprint/approvals/spec-governance--architecture-design.json records specHash c656335532db68bb5afa4b247bb534a47e3e089ebd898c0d7bb74f10ebf7084f, but the on-disk SHA-256 of .specs/proposed/automatic-verification-and-completion-loop.md is fa88389749ad8cdb67314c544a946250c70ea2dd66d045064892243bc5eec161. Approval is stale or the spec body was edited after approval — either way, exact-hash approval authority is broken and any implementation cycle cannot begin.

docs/user/features/spec-governance--architecture-design.i18n.yaml carries reviewed SHA-1 pair hashes that no longer match the on-disk docs (en 5ad49a9c… vs expected de7aa228…; zh 8c7587f9… vs expected 15a61938…). The reviewed semantic-equivalence handshake is stale; design-blueprint docs confirm would need to rerun.

AGENTS.md requires completion be claimed only after `design-blueprint scan` passes against the staged Git snapshot. Only the working-tree scan (--all) was run; the exact staged scan was not exercised.

Full Node suite (npm test) and individual node --test runs cannot execute in this verifier session: node:test runner fails with EPERM at child_process.spawn for piped stdio (sandbox boundary; approval prompts disabled so sandbox_permissions cannot be set). 0 tests ran; AC-DSH-001..013 cannot be certified by behavior in this round.
